title: glab api projects/${home}/pipelines/${pipeline}/jobs?per_page=100 --paginate
description: The jobs of a merge request's head pipeline, ${home} the id of the project the pipeline runs in, or this project's path URL-encoded when the merge request names none, which kit counts as the merge request's checks, the latest of each name, in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:open-prs, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::gitlab_runs); --paginate prints one such array per page. The types are APIEntitiesCiJob of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/jobs in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, and the status's values and the nullable times those of https://docs.gitlab.com/api/jobs/.

started_at.description: When the job started, null before it does.

finished_at.description: When the job finished, null before it does.
